description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experience evidence, or Express Entry file and evidence review. It returns the relevant Government of Canada source, named MAK licensed expert, MAK educational resource, and configured authority, publication, secondary-coverage, and institutional-reference sources where available. Do not use it to decide eligibility, evidence sufficiency, or outcomes.

battle.description: Choose the user source-navigation intent: spousal_pfl = spousal sponsorship, relationship evidence, or procedural fairness letter; business_financial = business immigration, source of funds, or financial evidence; cec_work_evidence = Canadian Experience Class employment or work-experience evidence; express_entry_review = Express Entry file or evidence review.
